apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
apps.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.2.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.2.0-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **crash**: Show persistent crash reports on Home
- **about**: Link the lyrics website and service status
- **player**: Search lyrics online for files without them
- **lyrics**: Add lrc.red and BetterLyrics, split SpotiFLAC-Mobile Lyrics
- **home**: Greet in the header and gather listening shortcuts
- **onboarding**: Introduce the 5.2 release tour
- **library**: Add adaptive icons to collection tabs
- **home**: Localize greetings and address profile names
- **home**: Expose extension country settings and isolate regional caches
- **lyrics**: Refresh quote sharing and load lyrics on demand
- **android**: Refresh launcher widgets with adaptive expressive layouts
- **player**: Add configurable full-screen cover art
- **player**: Synchronize music haptics with local playback
- **lyrics**: Share lyric cards and refine timed vocal transitions
- **player**: Show audio source processing and output details
- **equalizer**: Add multiband EQ and per-player native audio processing
- **autoplay**: Enable personalization by default and confirm learning resets
- **a11y**: Label controls and improve settings contrast and targets
- **i18n**: Add player feature text and clarify built-in playback
- **loading**: Align skeletons with collection and extension layouts
- **player**: Share volume controls across Material and Mornye
- **rewind**: Add yearly highlights and seasonal library banners
- **forms**: Adopt expressive inputs with consistent form state
- **ui**: Add themed menus and adaptive checkbox rows
- **ui**: Unify content cards and preserve press behavior
- **layout**: Adapt tablet navigation and center wide content
- **listening**: Show a skeleton while statistics load
- **listening**: Add Rewind highlights and refresh statistics
- **player**: Refine mini-player and queue feedback
- **library**: Add sectioned browsing and adaptive fast scrolling
- **material**: Unify progress and surface transitions
- **material**: Animate header action groups and collapse
- **settings**: Connect custom Material settings rows
- **settings**: Connect standard Material settings rows
- **ui**: Add Material Expressive spring motion
- **lyrics**: Add SpotiFLAC fallback for Apple Music outages
- **ui**: Extend Material Expressive surfaces and playback controls
- **theme**: Show a check on selected expressive switches
- **theme**: Adopt Material Symbols and expressive components
- **metadata**: Add per-field download tag separators

### Bug Fixes

- **crash**: Match the Home crash card to the error card style
- **library**: Recover interrupted scans and stale notifications
- **downloads**: Offer folder recovery for permission failures
- **equalizer**: Keep headroom and limiter choices when applying a preset
- **lyrics**: Restore QQ Music search after the desktop CGI broke
- **player**: Restore the lighter full-screen cover scrim
- **storage**: Retain legacy Android cipher migration support
- **library**: Recover missing local album artwork from audio
- **library**: Restore bit depth as the default quality badge
- **haptics**: Analyze document audio across skips and AutoMix
- **player**: Report Android output failures without skipping tracks
- **network**: Request Android 17 local network access before NAS connections
- **theme**: Retain dominant cover colors in player backgrounds
- **automix**: Align effect handoffs and render sufficient source audio
- **downloads**: Recover native queues when their service dies
- **verification**: Bound browser handoffs and release expired dialogs
- **player**: Size volume slider handle proportionally
- **settings**: Use shared sheet for log level selection
- **headers**: Fit artwork and unify toolbar controls
- **metadata**: Align separator picker with Settings components
- **settings**: Unify adaptive sheet layout and drag behavior
- **player**: Expose favorites and shuffle in Material notifications
- **audio**: Preserve FLAC precision in Android bit-perfect playback
- **extensions**: Use adaptive icons for installed extension avatars
- **library**: Align filter and sort sheet sizing and dismissal
- **player**: Prevent overlapping titles during rapid skips
- **storage**: Preserve audio MIME when publishing SAF downloads
- **lyrics**: Refresh LRC sidecars in their actual SAF folder
- **download**: Probe M4A streams before preserving requested FLAC
- **automix**: Wait for advancing audio before starting fades

### Performance

- **lyrics**: Compile credit regexes once
- **library**: Build DateFormat and RegExp once instead of per row
- **history**: Suppress unchanged membership notifications
- **history**: Reuse unchanged download lookup indexes
- **releases**: Narrow weekly release provider dependencies
- **lyrics**: Cache timed lyric segment geometry
- **player**: Cache adjacent track titles during swipes

### Refactoring

- **android**: Share the SAF scan percent and CUE helpers
- **android**: Move SAF batch exists and modtime queries out of MainActivitySafScan.kt
- **android**: Move SAF tree listing and executors out of MainActivitySafScan.kt
- **android**: Move SAF CUE helpers out of MainActivitySafScan.kt
- **android**: Move SAF scan checkpointing out of MainActivitySafScan.kt
- **android**: Move SAF file inspection out of MainActivitySafScan.kt
- **android**: Put the SAF IO helpers on Context receivers
- **android**: Share the foreground wake lock and start helper between the two services
- **providers**: Share one Coalescer for single-flight request coalescing
- **android**: Move the lifecycle backend calls into MainActivityLifecycleCalls.kt
- **android**: Move the download service and worker backend calls into MainActivityServiceCalls.kt
- **android**: Move the library scan backend calls into MainActivityLibraryScanCalls.kt
- **android**: Move the metadata and tag backend calls into MainActivityMetadataCalls.kt
- **android**: Move the SAF backend calls into MainActivitySafCalls.kt
- **android**: Move install state, extension intents, SAF leases and small channels out of MainActivity.kt
- **library**: Split local_library_provider.dart into source, scan and cover parts
- **library**: Share the scan completion tail as _finishScan
- **library**: Remove the unreachable snapshot sub-branch of the incremental scan
- **convert**: Route single-track conversion through the shared pipeline
- **queue**: Move the completion bridge into CompletionBridgeTracker
- **queue**: Move library paging state into QueueLibraryPager
- **bridge**: Share one generic cache entry and put/prune helper
- **collections**: Move playlist cover file I/O into PlaylistCoverStore
- **cache**: Move directory scanning and clearing into CacheMaintenanceService
- **analysis**: Move the FFmpeg runner out of the widget
- **analysis**: Move the analysis disk cache into audio_analysis_cache.dart
- **analysis**: Move the pure FFmpeg builders and parsers to a service
- **setup**: Move SharedPreferences access behind SetupProgressStore and SafMigrationPromptStore
- **providers**: Move UI-declared providers to lib/providers
- **rust**: Rename mod.rs modules to the foo.rs + foo/ layout
- **concerts**: Move the calendar channel into a service
- **repo**: Prepare install paths in the repo notifier
- **share**: Share the widget capture helper
- **extensions**: Share the extension health color and icon helpers
- **playlists**: Share the playlist name prompt and dispose its controller
- **artist**: Move the discography download into a part
- **home**: Use downloadSingleTrack for search results
- **storage**: Share the SAF download tree pick
- **layout**: Share responsiveScale and effectiveTextScale
- **layering**: Move logic files out of screens
- **layering**: Move model files to models and fix inverted imports
- **layering**: Move UI action helpers from services and utils to controllers
- **core**: Add fs::write_atomic and use it for the atomic file writes
- **rust**: Consolidate small duplicate helpers
- **core**: Move the lenient Go-style JSON decoder to core::json
- **me…
